web_fixture.title: Redirect errors - Ashcott CDN
web_fixture.snippet: AC-4210 is raised when a request follows more than 16 redirect hops.
web_fixture.content:
# Redirect errors

Ashcott CDN, reviewed 2026-01-30.

| code | raised when | what to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AC-4204 | the origin sends a location header the edge cannot read | fix the header at the origin |
| AC-4210 | a request follows more than 16 redirect hops | shorten the chain or answer the request directly |
| AC-4288 | an edge rule hands the request back to its own rule | take the loop out of the rule |

The hop ceiling counts the redirects the edge follows for one request. A chain
of sixteen redirects is served; the seventeenth ends on AC-4210.

web_fixture.title: Edge rule limits - Ashcott CDN
web_fixture.snippet: An edge rule may hand a request through 8 internal hops before the request goes back to the browser.
web_fixture.content:
# Edge rule limits

Ashcott CDN.

An edge rule may hand a request through 8 internal hops before the request goes
back to the browser. The count covers hops inside the edge rule; redirects the
browser follows afterwards are counted separately.
